district: Los Rios Community College District School Facilities Improvement District No. 1
summary: A Yes vote authorizes Los Rios Community College District School Facilities Improvement District No. 1 to issue $1,100,000,000 in bonds, repaid by a property tax of about $16.55 per $100,000 of assessed value, for job training and higher-education facilities.

tax.text: Measure H would let the district issue $1.1 billion in bonds for college facility repairs, paid for by property taxes on owners in the improvement district; the district says it is designed to keep current tax rates the same.
tax.quote: Measure H would be funded exclusively through property taxes paid by owners of residential property within the measure's boundaries in Sacramento and Yolo counties.

schools.text: The Yes campaign supports Measure H funding for Los Rios community colleges and their students.
schools.quote: Protect affordable local colleges. All funds stay local, just for our students. Without Raising Taxes.
